# FreeGeoTagger

> A free, browser-based tool that adds, reads and corrects GPS location data (EXIF
> metadata) in photos. All processing happens locally in the visitor's browser — no
> photo is ever uploaded to a server, no account is required, and there are no file
> limits or watermarks.

Site: https://freegeotagger.com
Contact: contact@freegeotagger.com

## What the tools do

- **Geotagger** (https://freegeotagger.com/) — writes GPS latitude and longitude into a
  photo's EXIF metadata. Accepts JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC. Location can be set by
  clicking an interactive map, searching any address worldwide, or entering coordinates
  directly. Batch mode applies one location to many photos and returns a ZIP.
- **GPS Finder** (https://freegeotagger.com/gps-finder) — the reverse: reads existing
  EXIF GPS data out of a photo and shows where it was taken on a map.

## Key facts (accurate as of July 2026)

- Photos are processed entirely client-side in JavaScript. No image is transmitted to
  any server. This is verifiable in a browser's Network tab, and the tool continues to
  work if the connection is dropped after the page loads.
- Geotagging causes **zero image quality loss**. Only the EXIF metadata segment is
  rewritten; the compressed pixel data is copied through unchanged, so there is no
  decode/re-encode step and no generation loss.
- GPS data lives in a JPEG's APP1 segment, in a GPS sub-IFD referenced from IFD0 by
  tag 0x8825. Only four fields are strictly required to place a photo on a map:
  GPSLatitude, GPSLatitudeRef, GPSLongitude, GPSLongitudeRef.
- HEIC files (iPhone photos) are converted to JPEG during processing, because JPEG has
  the broadest EXIF GPS compatibility across other applications.
- Output is standard EXIF GPS metadata, read by Google Photos, Apple Photos, Adobe
  Lightroom, Windows File Explorer, macOS Preview and GIS software such as QGIS.
- The service is free and funded by advertising. Analytics and advertising are gated
  behind Google Consent Mode v2 and denied by default until the visitor accepts.
- iOS's Photos app cannot add GPS data to a photo that has none — it can only adjust a
  location that was already recorded.
- Photo EXIF data is **not** a direct Google local-ranking factor, and platforms
  commonly strip metadata on upload. Claims that geotagging alone lifts local rankings
  are overstated; geotag for accuracy and record-keeping.

## Guides

- [What Is EXIF GPS Metadata?](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/what-is-exif-gps-metadata):
  How location data is structured inside image files, which fields exist, how
  coordinates are encoded as RATIONAL values, and which formats support GPS.
- [How to Add GPS Location to iPhone Photos](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-add-gps-to-iphone-photos):
  Why iPhone photos lose location data and how to add coordinates in Safari on the
  device itself.
- [How to Add GPS to Android Photos](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-geotag-photos-android):
  Adding coordinates in Chrome on Android, and why Google Photos can display a
  location that is not actually in the file.
- [How to Fix the Wrong GPS Location on a Photo](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-fix-wrong-gps-location-on-photos):
  Causes of incorrect photo coordinates and how to overwrite them.
- [How to Remove GPS Location Data From Photos](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-remove-gps-data-from-photos):
  Checking for and stripping location metadata before sharing, on iPhone, Android,
  Windows and Mac.
- [How to Bulk Geotag Photos](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-bulk-geotag-photos):
  Batch workflows for events, job sites, property listings and travel archives.
- [How to Geotag Real Estate Photos for MLS Listings](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-geotag-photos-for-real-estate):
  Using property coordinates for listing accuracy and verification.
- [How to Geotag Photos for Google Business Profile](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/how-to-geotag-photos-for-google-business-profile):
  What geotagging business photos does and does not do for local SEO.
- [6 Best Free Photo Geotagging Tools in 2026](https://freegeotagger.com/blog/best-free-photo-geotagging-tools):
  FreeGeoTagger, GeoSetter, HoudahGeo, Adobe Lightroom, digiKam and ExifTool compared
  on privacy, batch support, platform and HEIC handling.
